how: Finish the setup link at setup.chloeeai.co. Open https://app.[THEIR DOMAIN]/api/health, then click Create an account with the owner email.
expected: Health page answers. The owner account is created and opens Overview. A second address can't create an account without an invite.

how: In Railway, Account Settings, Tokens: delete the setup token. If the wizard handled DNS, delete the Cloudflare token too. Turn on backups on the Postgres service's Backups tab.
expected: No setup tokens left. A backup schedule shows on the Postgres service.

how: On the centre's page, Test call, Talk to this receptionist. Ask one question and hang up.
expected: It answers with the approved greeting. The call shows under Calls with an outcome and transcript.

how: Buy a number on the centre's page and wait until it's connected. From a mobile, call it with fictional family details.
expected: It answers within a few rings with the director-approved greeting. The call shows under Calls in the centre's workspace and in your Overview.
reference: Mobile used; time; call ID (Calls > open the call > Provider)

how: On the same call, ask one approved question, for example opening hours or parking.
expected: The answer matches the director's approved wording in Business knowledge. It doesn't promise a place, enrolment or fee.

how: Ask to book a centre tour. Pick one of the times offered. Give a fictional name, phone and an email you can check.
expected: It offers times inside the active hours, books one and says it's confirmed. The tour shows in Bookings in the centre's workspace.

how: Call again and ask for the exact same tour time.
expected: It says that time isn't free and offers other times. No second booking or event is made for that time.

how: Open the centre's connected Google or Outlook calendar.
expected: Exactly one event at the booked time, with the parent's name and phone in the description.

how: Check the fictional parent's inbox and the Email each booking to address.
expected: The parent gets a confirmation email from your domain. Staff get "New booking: [name], [service]". Both show as delivered in Resend, Emails.

how: During active hours, call and ask to speak to a person.
expected: Caller hears "putting you through to [name]" and the urgent-calls number rings. The call shows under Calls.

how: Call outside the centre's active hours (or set today's hours to closed for the test, then set them back). Ask for a call back.
expected: It tells the caller the centre is closed, doesn't put the call through, and takes a message. It shows in Follow-ups. Staff get "Call back: [name]" by email.

how: Create a second test centre. Invite a different email as Viewer under Customers with access. Sign in as that person in a private window. Try to open the first centre's calls and bookings.
expected: They see only the second centre. The first centre's calls, bookings and follow-ups aren't listed and can't be opened.

how: Sign out. On the sign-in page click Forgot password?, enter the owner email and follow the link.
expected: Reset email arrives from your domain. The link sets a new password. The new password signs in and the old one doesn't.

how: Before any real centre goes live: leave a test callback (call 1), then make a manual backup on the Postgres service's Backups tab. Leave a second test callback (call 2). Restore the backup, review in Details, then Deploy.
expected: After the restore the dashboard loads, call 1's follow-up is there and call 2's is gone. Calendar connections still work.
reference: Backup date and time; restore time
